2) The Chief Engineer (H), Construction and Maintenance has sent the announcement proposal for the work of “Preparation of Detailed Project report for Reducing Traffic Congestion, Providing Parking facilities, Widening and Improving of Ghat section in Kodaikanal”. The details are as follows:-

(i). Kodaikanal is one of the very popular holiday destination hill resorts in South India. This hill station stands at 6700 foot (2030 m) above sea level and situated in upper Palani Hills of the Western Ghats near Madurai in Tamil Nadu. Kodaikanal is also popularly known as the princess of Hill stations. Indian institute of astrophysics, TV station, University, Radio station and Central sheep farms are situated in this Hill station. There are more than 50 villages and most of the villagers are primarily engaged in agriculture. The population is more than 3 Lakh and floating population is also more than 2 Lakh. Tourists from inland and foreign are visiting Kodaikanal throughout the year.

(ii). Due to heavy inflow of Tourists throughout the year, Kodaikanal roads are stuck with heavy traffic congestion. It is necessary to improve the Ghat section to facilitate visits of tourists from all over India and abroad and to provide free flow of traffic without any congestion. It is proposed to ensure that they save time and avail facilities of car parking and bus bay etc. By identifying the bottle neck spots, blind curves etc and improving the geometric and removing the black spots it is proposed to avoid accidents.

The Sugarcane variety Co 86032 is being cultivated for more than 25 years in around 50 percent of the total Sugarcane area in Tamil Nadu leading to reduced recovery.
